Neither man knew who had sent the message, but Elias placed the bottle on his windowsill, facing the sea.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一台暂时停歇的机器。高架桥上偶有汽车掠过，尾灯在潮湿的路面拖出细长红线。便利店仍亮着白光，店员伏在柜台后打盹。远处写字楼的玻璃映着稀薄月色，几扇窗里还亮着灯，像没有熄灭的星。清洁车缓慢驶过街角，扫帚摩擦地面发出沙沙声。风从空荡的巷子穿过，带来早餐铺蒸笼的热气。天还没亮，早起的人和未眠的人，在同一座城里各自沉默。","w03":"- Recursion is when a set of instructions solves a problem by asking itself to solve a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Like opening a stack of nesting dolls, each step opens one smaller doll until it reaches the tiniest one.\n- The tiniest case stops the process, and then the answers come back up through all the larger steps."}
